text:
maria_cs: Starting warmup for AcmeCorp dedicated pool. Plan: priming + autoscale smoke this afternoon. Can infra confirm quota bump + KMS access?
ben_infra: Confirmed quota bump for pool-acme-01 (250 RPS target). KMS key rotation is pending security review — ETA ~24h.
owen_sre: We'll run a staged 30m ramp (10rps -> 250rps) at 14:00 PT. Any special prompt shapes to include?
lucy_onboard: Please include heavy-context chat threads (8k tokens), dense embedding batches, and short burst generation spikes. I'll drop anonymized samples.
maria_cs: Uploading sample payloads to /shared/warmup/acme/sample.tar.gz :link: (contains chat/emb/parallel-reqs).
ben_infra: Scheduler job queued: `warmup-run --pool acme-01 --profile steady-saw --duration 1800` — will post run id once started.
deploy-bot: Warmup job queued (id: w-20260405-17). Note: no customer KMS yet; job will run with ephemeral key fallback. React with :eyes: if OK.
owen_sre: If KMS missing, add fallback to ephemeral keys + masked logs. Also enable KV cache priming to avoid cold-cache penalties.
maria_cs: Agreed. Renewal team marked this account medium-risk if SLA targets slip. Tagging account exec to observe.
lucy_onboard: Can we do two canaries separated by 15m? First with quantized model v1-q, second with v1-fp16 to compare latency/cost.
ben_infra: Yup. Autoscaler config uploaded:
```
pool: acme-01
min_nodes: 2
max_nodes: 8
scale_up_threshold_gpu_util: 0.70
scale_down_threshold_gpu_util: 0.30
cooldown_seconds: 60
fallback_route: hosted-api
```
own_sre: I'll monitor p95 latency, KV cache hit rate, GPU util. If p95 > 800ms for >2m, we trigger fallback to hosted-route and notify CS.
maria_cs: Add postmortem template to the run: /playbooks/warmup-postmortem.md. @jessica_sales please join the 14:00 PT watch window. :calendar: 
lucy_onboard: Roger. I'll run the sample generator short loop at T-10 min and validate payload shapes.
ben_infra: Warmup started (id: w-20260405-17) at 14:03 PT. First canary (v1-q) in progress. Posting simple healthcheck: `curl -sS https://acme-01.internal/health | jq .` -> {"status":"ok","gpu_util":0.12} 
ben_infra: Mid-run update: scale-up to 4 nodes at 14:09 PT (gpu_util spiked to 76%).
owen_sre: Observed: KV hit rate improving from 0% -> 64% after priming. p95 stayed ~420ms under v1-q. No errors.
maria_cs: Great. Keep an eye on error budget; remind ops to capture any 5xx traces.
ben_infra: Second canary (v1-fp16) started 14:20 PT. If results look good we'll flip some traffic to dedicated for the renewal demo tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Warmup job completed (id: w-20260405-17) status: SUCCESS. Summary: 2 canaries, peak 6 nodes, avg p95=430ms (v1-q) / 360ms (v1-fp16), no 5xx > 30s.
maria_cs: Filing summary to the account doc and scheduling a short sync with the renewal team. Thanks all. :rocket:
